brief: make the cartoon on the golf course

panels.speaker: drew
panels.caption: We booked early and still got assigned a layover.
panels.action: Drew holds a folded tee sheet while Mango idles a golf cart beside a teed ball.
panels.setting: a golf course fairway on a fine day: mown turf underfoot with the mower's stripes running away behind them, a flagstick on a green in the middle distance, mature trees along both sides and a low clubhouse roof beyond the trees
panels.scene: Drew holds a folded tee sheet while Mango idles a golf cart beside a teed ball. CAMERA: eye level, close in, BOTH of them filling the frame from roughly the waist up with the place reading clearly behind them — never a wide landscape with small figures in it. Each character is seen in THREE-QUARTER view, angled into the frame so the face and both eyes are readable, turned toward each other rather than toward us. NOBODY looks out of the panel at the reader. They are the only figures in the picture: no other people anywhere, near or far.
